why: Every slot but Crutchfield is a major reviewer that bought and tested the speakers. SoundGuys answers the exact under-$200 question with a tested pick and MSRP; What Hi-Fi (two pages, one budget-tiered), Tom's Guide, TechRadar, RTINGS and WIRED all answer it in large part with tested picks that fall inside the budget. Strictly only one page is cut at $200, but six household-name testers covering the same models leaves no room for a small comparison site to displace them.
